messages.subject: [acs-r] 5-year data lookups for 2013
messages.body_plain:
I am receiving an error for just the 2013, 5-year data when using acs.lookup such as: sex.by.age = acs.lookup(table.number="B01001", span=5, endyear=2013). The error within R reads: Error: XML content does not seem to be XML: ''

The request can be made for the 2013, 1-year data, or another year of the 5-year estimates, without issue. Any thoughts?

Thank you,
Sara

messages.subject: [acs-r] ACS 5-year for 2013
messages.body_plain:
Similar to a prior thread, appears that 5-year ACS data is missing from the
"acs" package (2.1.3). To replicate:

```
key <- {KEY}
place_name <- "Los Angeles city"
state <- "CA"
year <- 2013
geo <- acs::geo.make(state = c(state), place = place_name)
acs::acs.fetch(endyear = year, span = 5, geography = geo,
  table.number = "B23025", col.names = "pretty",
  key = key)
```

which results in:

```
Error: XML content does not seem to be XML: ''
```

Other years and span seems to work. This problem can be replicated across
various tables.

Attempted to try `acs.tables.install()` which generated a lot of activity,
but rerunning the code did not work.

I am not quite sure how these queries are assembled, but checked the ACS
API which seemed to return valid data, e.g.,
https://api.census.gov/data/2013/acs/acs5?get=B23025_001E&for=place:*
-- 


Tom Schenk Jr.
tomschenkjr at gmail.com
tomschenkjr.net
